messages:
acme-sre: Hey – after the role-sync this morning our users lost access to the Models list and the Billing tab in the console. Org org-6371. API calls to model endpoints are returning 403 Model:access_denied. Billing page in UI shows a blank state / 404. We didn’t change anything on our side, rolling panic here. Any quick help?
jen-support: Sorry about that — can you share the org id and one affected user email? Also did you recently change any custom role mappings or enable any enforcement flags?
acme-sre: Org: org-6371, user: sara@acme.com. We flipped attribute-based enforcement last week (per the internal PR) but didn’t touch mappings afterwards.
kevin-security: Looking. Heads-up — we rolled a change that defaults role-sync jobs to abac-enforce=true at ~08:02 UTC this morning. If an org’s role templates lack explicit attribute mappings for certain resource families (billing, model.*), the effective grants can be dropped during enforcement.
kevin-security: Short-term fix is to add explicit grants for billing.read and model.invoke to the org role mapping, or temporarily re-run the role-sync with abac-enforce=false. I can push a one-off patch for you now.
acme-sre: Please patch, that would be great. We need the billing page back for finance to confirm charges.
ops-bot: Deploy: rbac-role-sync-fix will be applied to org-6371 (canary) — initiated by kevin-security at 08:19 UTC.
kevin-security: Applying patch (op id: op-8923). If you have internal admin access you can also run this snippet to add the mapping immediately:

```bash
curl -X POST "https://internal-admin.redwood/api/v1/orgs/org-6371/role-mappings" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"role_name":"acme-default","grants":["billing.read","model.invoke"],"attributes":{"project":"*"}}'
```

kevin-security: I applied the one-off mapping for acme-default and re-ran role-sync.
acme-sre: Trying now — Models list is back and Billing tab is visible. API model calls return 200 again. Thank you!
anya-eng: Follow-up note: we'll change the role-sync template to include default mappings for billing.* and model.* so ABAC enforcement doesn't remove those grants. Also adding an audit marker whenever abac-enforce toggles for an org.
jen-support: Leaving this open for a bit to confirm stability. @acme-sre can you confirm you want us to close the thread after you validate for one hour?
acme-sre: Confirmed — access looks stable. Close when ready. :white_check_mark: :heart:
